home.hero.title: MOT, servicing and repairs for every make
home.hero.lead: Dennis runs his workshop on the Goudlaan in The Hague. Come here for the annual MOT, a service, a repair or the air conditioning. Whatever make you drive.
home.rdw.title: Approved test centre
home.rdw.text: Garagebedrijf Dennis is an MOT test centre approved by the RDW, the Dutch vehicle authority. The test is carried out here, in our own workshop.

home.services.lead: From the annual test to a repair that cannot wait. The work is carried out in the workshop on the Goudlaan itself.
service.apk.title: MOT test
service.apk.text: We are an RDW-approved MOT test centre. Your car is tested here, so you do not have to take it anywhere else.
service.repair.title: Repairs
service.repair.text: From a loose exhaust to a worn wheel bearing or brake hoses. Repairs are carried out for every make.

service.smallService.title: Minor service

service.maintenance.title: Regular maintenance
service.maintenance.text: Periodic maintenance keeps your car reliable and helps you avoid unpleasant surprises.
service.aircon.title: Air conditioning

meta.services.title: Services | Garagebedrijf Dennis in The Hague
services.title: Maintenance, MOT and repairs
services.lead: Garagebedrijf Dennis works on every make. Below is what happens in the workshop on the Goudlaan.
service.apk.long: Garagebedrijf Dennis is an MOT test centre approved by the RDW, the Dutch vehicle authority. The test takes place here in our own workshop, so your car does not have to go to another address.
service.repair.long: If something breaks, it gets repaired here. Think of a loose exhaust, a worn wheel bearing, brake hoses or lights that no longer do what they should.
service.repair.li2: From a small job to a larger repair
service.repair.li3: Carried out in our own workshop
service.bigService.long: The extensive service. The car is checked all round according to the maintenance schedule that belongs to the model and the mileage.
service.bigService.li1: According to the manufacturer's maintenance schedule
service.bigService.li2: A check of the main components
service.smallService.long: The limited service for maintenance in between, meant for the moment when a full service is not yet due.
service.maintenance.long: Periodic maintenance keeps your car reliable and prevents small faults from growing into an expensive repair.
service.maintenance.li3: Can be combined with the MOT
service.aircon.long: If the air conditioning no longer cools properly, we will take a look at it. Installing and repairing air conditioning systems is part of the work in the workshop.
services.steps.title: How to make an appointment
services.steps.lead: No complicated system is needed. A phone call or a visit to the workshop is enough.
services.step1.title: Call the garage
services.step1.text: Reachable on weekdays and on Saturday on 070-3080596 and on 06-16724822.
services.step2.title: Drop by
services.step2.text: The workshop is at Goudlaan 63 in The Hague. Walking in during opening hours is fine too.
services.step3.title: Talking it through
services.step3.text: We talk through with you what is needed and what the options are.
meta.services.desc: MOT testing, repairs, major and minor servicing, regular maintenance and air conditioning. All under one roof at Garagebedrijf Dennis on the Goudlaan in The Hague.

privacy.controllerNote: No email address and no Chamber of Commerce number were supplied while this website was being built. Those details are therefore deliberately left out here, rather than filling in something that is not correct.
privacy.dataIntro: This website has no contact form and no login. You can visit the site without leaving any details behind. So we do not ask for your name, your phone number or your email address.
privacy.dataStorage: The website stores one thing in your own browser: the language you pick with the language button. That happens in your browser's local storage, stays on your device and is never sent to us. You can clear that storage yourself through your browser settings.
privacy.why: Your language choice is kept so that you do not have to pick again on a following visit. If you call us, we of course process the details you give during that conversation, but that is separate from this website.
privacy.thirdIntro: This website uses the following external services. Your IP address may reach those parties in the process.
privacy.table.fonts: Loading the fonts used on the website
privacy.table.maps: Showing the map on the contact page
privacy.retention: Because this website itself does not collect or store personal data on a server, there is nothing for us to keep. Details you pass on by phone are kept no longer than needed for the work on your car and the administration that goes with it.
privacy.right1: Access the data we hold about you
privacy.right4: Object to the processing of your data
privacy.rightsHow: You can make a request by phone on 070-3080596 or 06-16724822.
privacy.complaint: If you feel that we do not handle your data carefully, you can file a complaint with the Dutch Data Protection Authority at autoriteitpersoonsgegevens.nl.
meta.privacy.desc: Read how Garagebedrijf Dennis in The Hague handles personal data, which external services this website uses and how you can exercise your rights.
